description: Source code for WatchConnectivityReceiver class handling watch connectivity communication, message sending, and payload parsing in a watchOS app.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: Manages watch connectivity sessions, sending replies, and handling incoming messages and payloads.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the session is activated, retrying with delays if necessary.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to the watch, either immediately via sendMessage or queued via transferUserInfo.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Normalizes various object types into a [String: Any] dictionary.

methods.name: parseActions
methods.description: Parses action data from payload into WatchPromptAction objects.

methods.name: parseNotificationPayload
methods.description: Parses incoming payload into a WatchNotifyMessage if valid.
